item.title: 高考英语朗读真题027
item.description:
Gentle boundaries / are loving limits you set / to protect your time, / energy, / and emotional well-being. // They're not about / pushing people away; / instead, / they make space / for your needs. //

Gentle boundaries / matter in different areas of life, / including friendships, / family, / work, / and even social media. // That's because / they can help you live better / by relieving stress, / building more self-worth, / and strengthening relationships. //

Here are some tips / for practicing gentle boundaries. // The first thing you should do / is to get clear / on what you actually need, / such as more rest, / less access, / or emotional privacy. // Secondly, / use soft, clear language / to express your boundaries. // This is to ensure / that you won't confuse / the other person. // Lastly, / be ready / to feel uncomfortable / at the beginning, / especially if people are used to / asking for too much. //
